fediverse.title: Follow the blog from Mastodon
fediverse.intro: Mastodon is a social network like X or Threads, but nobody owns it: it is made of thousands of independent servers that talk to each other. {site} has its own account there, and you can follow it to get every new article.
fediverse.introShort: Mastodon is a social network like X or Threads, but nobody owns it: it is made of thousands of servers that talk to each other. {site} has its account there.

mail.title: It works like email
mail.text: With an email from one provider you can write to someone who uses another. It is the same here: from an account on any server you follow accounts on other servers.

address.title: Your address has two parts
address.text: The name comes first, then the server where the account lives. The blog's is {user} on the server {server}.
address.caption: Like an email: name {'@'} domain

apps.title: Many apps, one network
apps.text: Mastodon is the best known, but Pixelfed, PeerTube, Misskey and GoToSocial talk to each other too. That shared network is called the fediverse.

join.title: Create a free account in 3 steps
steps: Pick a server on joinmastodon.org. Any will do: from every server you can follow everyone.
Sign up with your email. It is free and ad-free.
Come back here, type your server and press “Follow”.

aside.title: An account with the bare minimum
aside.minimalText: Your email, your username and your encrypted password. Nothing else.
aside.trackersText: No ads and no third-party analytics. Your session lives in a cookie that no script on the page can read.
aside.leaveText: Delete your account and your data from My account, in one step.
aside.editorText: With the Editor role you see drafts with the real design before they are published. The administrator assigns the role.

meta.description: {site} does not track you: no ads, no tracking cookies and anonymous analytics. What data we keep and how to exercise your rights.

notice.label: Privacy notice
notice.text: No tracking cookies. We count visits anonymously with Umami.

privacy.title: Privacy and cookies
privacy.lead: In short: {site} does not track you. There are no ads, no tracking cookies and no third-party analytics building a profile of you.

facts.label: Summary
facts.session: Cookie, only when signed in | Cookies, only when signed in

analytics.label: Analytics
analytics.title: How we count visits
analytics.body: We use {umami} to know which articles get read. It records the page viewed, the site you came from, the browser, the operating system, the device type and the country. {noCookies}, keeps no data that identifies you and does not follow you from site to site.
analytics.blockers: If your browser sends the “Do Not Track” signal or you use a blocker, nothing happens: the blog works the same.

cookies.label: Cookies
cookies.title: A single cookie, and only if you sign in
cookies.caption: Cookies used by {site}
cookies.name: Name

bd_session.purpose: Keeps you signed in. Necessary: without it you cannot sign in to your account.

cookies.none: We use no analytics, advertising or social media cookies, so there is no need to ask for your consent or show you a banner.

browser.label: Your browser
browser.title: What is stored on your device
browser.body: Some preferences are kept in your browser’s local storage. {local} and you can delete them from your browser settings.

items.bd-privacy-notice: That you already closed the privacy notice.

data.label: Your data
data.title: What personal data we hold
data.none: None: this site has no accounts, newsletter or comments, so it keeps nothing that identifies you.
data.accountText: if you create one, your email, your username and your hashed password. You can delete it whenever you want from My account; your comments remain as “Anonymous”.
data.newsletterText: if you subscribe, your email, only to send you new articles. You can unsubscribe whenever you want from the link in any of our emails, and we delete your address.
data.commentsText: the name and the text you write, published after review. Replies from the fediverse arrive with your public Mastodon address.

rights.label: Your rights
rights.title: Know, correct or delete
rights.body: Under Colombia’s Law 1581 of 2012, you can access, update, correct and ask for the deletion of your personal data. Write to {email} and we will reply.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe
unsubscribe.lead: You will stop receiving new articles by email and we will delete your address.
unsubscribe.doneLead: You will no longer receive the newsletter and we deleted your email. You can subscribe again whenever you want.
unsubscribe.invalidLead: Use the “Unsubscribe” link in one of our emails. If the problem persists, write to {email}.
unsubscribe.error: We could not unsubscribe you. Try again in a moment.
